Bowhead Whale Spectrogram Gallery

Each spectrogram is a 121×104 pixel image spanning 0–500 Hz (vertical) and 3 seconds (horizontal), normalised per-sample to [0, 1] and coloured with the viridis colormap (dark = low energy, yellow = high energy). Samples are drawn from recording sites 3 and 5, Beaufort Sea 2008–2014.
